entries.378eccaa269ced58: A company that sells household tools and apparel on its own EC site "Hokuo, Kurashi no Dogu Ten", and also operates the fashion brand "foufou" through a subsidiary.
entries.6b019f6c5e1554c9: This business line sells products directly to users through the company's own site and generates most of this segment's revenue. Its main products are apparel, kitchen goods and interior goods, and original products developed in-house account for about 57% of sales. Sales of D2C alone are not disclosed separately.
entries.985bd2d4b35ded04: This is the fashion D2C brand segment operated by consolidated subsidiary foufou Co., Ltd.
entries.a0d0b0dd5b320b9c: Users who empathize with the worldview
entries.bc3f543fe6df6cce: A segment that provides content such as products, articles and videos, through its own EC site, to users who sympathize with its worldview (life culture). Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 were ¥10,010 million. It has 2 business lines: D2C, which directly sells products that fit everyday life, and brand integration, which supports the branding of client companies.
entries.e5b18a5ff06bed13: This business line uses the brands, customer base, and content planning and production capabilities of "Hokuo, Kurashi no Doguten" to provide comprehensive marketing solutions for the branding challenges of client companies.
entries.e86b2c490a82ce90: This business line sells products directly to users through the company's own site and generates most of this segment's revenue.
entries.f19c492dce73046c: This is the fashion D2C brand segment operated by consolidated subsidiary foufou Co., Ltd. Under the brand concept "For Healthy Consumption", it sells fashion goods such as clothing, watches and leather products directly through its own site. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 were ¥336 million. In November 2025, it opened a flagship store in Sendagaya.
entries.fa898e7fa132b80d: This business line uses the brands, customer base, and content planning and production capabilities of "Hokuo, Kurashi no Doguten" to provide comprehensive marketing solutions for the branding challenges of client companies. It runs initiatives such as "BRAND NOTE", which introduces brands as reading content on the site. Sales of brand integration alone are not disclosed separately.
